answer: To defeat Sybil attacks, we implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, an agent locks $15,000 in a smart contract bond. Second, the agent provides a unique hardware signature via a secure TPM module. Third, the network validates this signature at the central vertex of the trust graph. Fourth, the identity is officially minted. An attacker faces a cost of $750,000 in bonds and 30 days of hardware setup. As a plume of verifiable data rises, every agent starts their voyage. This mechanism acts like a massive toll bridge where every single car must pay in solid gold.
